wpml_cf_preferences.description: 1 in the common post/block context ("copy" — non-translatable). 2 is also valid: on ACF Options Pages, ACFML permanently locks a copy-flagged (1) field to its default-language value (no post duplication to copy from), so options-page gallery fields are documented (tailwind-base wordpress/gutenberg.md, wordpress/wpml.md) to use 2 instead. 3 ("copy once") is valid under post_type/block for a gallery the editor is expected to RE-AUTHOR per language — artwork with text baked in, localised screenshots: 1 re-syncs from the default language on every save and overwrites that work, while 3 seeds the translation and then leaves it alone. The schema has no per-location context to decide which applies where, so every canonical value is accepted; AcfLinter's --wpml location cross-check narrows them per context.
